info.title: Smart Lab and Room Booking API
info.description: Booking backend with Microsoft Graph one-way creation, rescheduling and cancellation of confirmed bookings. Confirmed events can invite the person the booking is for (OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE); room and equipment availability remains managed by the booking system. Outlook credentials must be configured locally; sync status is independent of booking status. University SSO and durable database remain adapter integration points. Recurring bookings are not supported yet. Demo authentication and memory data are local-development-only. All paths retain trailing slashes; request timestamps require offsets and responses use UTC Z. Identity includes university_email. Students, Admins and Managers book under the same rules; an Admin or Manager may also book on behalf of someone (student_id is the person the booking is for, created_by who created it), and only a Manager decides urgent requests and reschedules. A student may submit a request only when the induction for the resource, and any prerequisite induction it lists (for example Advanced needs General), is verified and current through the booking end. Every request starts as PENDING_APPROVAL and holds its slot during a review window (pending_hold_minutes, default 1440 = 24 hours, Manager-configurable per resource, capped at the booking start). An Admin or Manager approves or rejects it within the window; if nobody decides, the system approves it when it still follows the rules (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) and rejects it otherwise (AUTO_REJECTED_*). Requests for time that is already taken or held are WAITLISTED in submission order and, when the time frees up, become PENDING_APPROVAL with a fresh review window. Induction evidence is always reviewed manually. Bookings must start at least 7 and at most 30 days ahead by default; these values come from a RulesProvider (booking/rules.py, environment variables by default) so they can be changed without code changes. Authentication and resource-specific eligibility are separate. Verified induction expires a fixed number of days after approval (qualification_validity_days from the RulesProvider, default 120, one term); reviewers do not supply an expiry. Admin and Manager can query the audit trail of requests, approvals, changes and cancellations. The prototype seed has 2 labs and 20 independently bookable devices. A Manager has every Admin permission and can also configure booking policies, add staff accounts and deactivate accounts. Admins cannot use any Manager endpoint. Students, Admins and Managers are separate accounts whose role is fixed when created: students are never promoted to staff, and Admin and Manager do not switch. Creating, approving, automatically deciding, promoting from the waitlist and rescheduling all use one shared rule check (account active, resource available, valid time, booking window on create and reschedule, induction and prerequisites). A Manager can mark a resource MAINTENANCE or CLOSED (new requests paused, existing bookings kept) and list or export every booking. Staff accounts are created with Add staff (POST /admin/users/staff/). Equipment records the room it is kept in (room_id); a room's maintenance does not affect its equipment. Two sign-in entry points: students use university sign-in (demo: POST /auth/demo-login/, which refuses staff with USE_STAFF_SIGN_IN); Admins and Managers use the staff page with zID and password (POST /auth/staff-sign-in/). A Manager's Add staff issues an invite code that the staff member uses once to choose a password (POST /auth/staff-activate/); Reset access issues a new code. Password hashes never appear in responses. Outlook sync is one way. The system never reads changes made in Outlook, so nothing done there can bypass the rules or become an approved booking; if a person deleted the event, a Manager's reschedule writes it again at the new time. Invitations follow OUTLOOK_INVITE_MODE (default allowlist: only OUTLOOK_ALLOWED_ATTENDEES are invited). POST /admin/outlook/check/ tests the Microsoft sign-in. Resources have an equipment category, and GET /resources/day-overview/ returns every matching resource's free and taken times on one day for the booking page filter and grid. Demo staff accounts use the password 123. Each person has a private calendar subscription link (GET calendar/link/, feed GET calendar/{token}.ics) that Outlook, Google or Apple Calendar read by themselves. Website notifications (GET notifications/) tell people about decisions and changes. Approved bookings need a check-in (POST bookings/{id}/check-in/) around the start; at the fourth missed check-in (configurable) booking is frozen for 30 days, later bookings are cancelled, and staff decide unfreeze requests. At most 3 bookings per person per week (configurable). Staff can book a weekly series (bookings/series/), approved at once. Managers add, edit, archive and restore rooms and equipment (admin/resources/) and read a usage report (admin/reports/usage/). Staff change their own password (auth/change-password/). Reminders appear in the notification bell the day before an approved booking and when a verified induction expires soon.

post.summary: Create a room or individual equipment booking request
post.description: Any active account: Admins and Managers book under the same rules as students and may book on behalf of someone else with on_behalf_of_zid; the booking belongs to that person (student_id, whose induction is checked) and created_by records the creator. Urgent requests (urgent=true, urgent_reason) may start inside the minimum advance window; they are PENDING_APPROVAL with reason URGENT_AWAITING_MANAGER, review_due_at null and hold_until = start, only a Manager can decide them (URGENT_NEEDS_MANAGER) and they expire at the start if undecided. Requires a VERIFIED, unexpired induction for the selected resource, and for each of its prerequisite inductions, through the booking end; otherwise 403 QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED (details.qualification_status, requirement_id; PREREQUISITE_REQUIRED adds prerequisite_id and prerequisite_status), including while evidence is still PENDING. The local start date must be from today + MIN_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 7) to today + MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS (default 30): BOOKING_TOO_SOON / BOOKING_TOO_FAR_AHEAD (400, details.earliest_date, latest_date, min_advance_days, max_advance_days). A user who already has an overlapping active request for this same resource receives DUPLICATE_BOOKING (409); terminal requests do not block rebooking and different resources remain independent. If no APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (reason AWAITING_REVIEW) with review_due_at = hold_until = min(start, now + pending_hold_minutes, default 1440). An Admin/Manager decides within that window; when it ends undecided the system re-checks the rules and sets APPROVED (AUTO_APPROVED_AFTER_REVIEW_WINDOW) or REJECTED (AUTO_REJECTED_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE, AUTO_REJECTED_QUALIFICATION, AUTO_REJECTED_RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTO_REJECTED_BOOKING_RULES or AUTO_REJECTED_CONFLICT), reviewed_by SYSTEM. If an APPROVED booking or active pending request overlaps, the request becomes WAITLISTED (reason TIME_CONFLICT or TEMPORARY_HOLD_CONFLICT) with waitlist_position. When time frees up (cancellation, rejection, expiry, rescheduling, an automatic rejection or a resource reopening) the earliest waitlisted request that now fits becomes PENDING_APPROVAL (PROMOTED_FROM_WAITLIST) with a fresh review window, or REJECTED with the failing rule's code (for example QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED or ACCOUNT_INACTIVE). Only APPROVED creates an Outlook event. Undecided and waitlisted requests expire at their start time. HTTP 201 never means approved. Interval semantics are [start, end). Booking frozen after missed check-ins: 403 ACCOUNT_FROZEN (details.frozen_until). At most MAX_BOOKINGS_PER_WEEK (default 3) pending, waitlisted or approved bookings per person per local week (Monday to Sunday), staff weekly series excluded: 409 WEEKLY_LIMIT_REACHED (details.limit, count, week_start). An explicitly enabled self-only test session may bypass booking policy; see auth/test-session/. Bypass availability uses latest_date=null, test_bypass=true and no review wait.

The old period is released and offered to the waitlist. A successful Outlook sync updates the existing event rather than creating another event. The new length may differ from the old one within the resource's max_booking_minutes. Moving a single booking into a week where the person already has MAX_BOOKINGS_PER_WEEK bookings returns 409 WEEKLY_LIMIT_REACHED (weekly series dates are exempt).

A REJECTED decision requires a reason and rejects the user's undecided bookings (PENDING_APPROVAL and WAITLISTED) for resources requiring this qualification with reason_code QUALIFICATION_REJECTED and the same reason, releasing their slots and offering them to the waitlist. updated_bookings lists every booking changed. valid_until is not accepted in the request; sending it returns 400.

post.summary: Approve or reject a booking request
post.description: Admin or Manager only; an Admin cannot decide their own request (SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN, 403). Decide within the request's review window (review_due_at); afterwards the system decides automatically. APPROVED is allowed only for PENDING_APPROVAL requests; it re-checks resource-specific qualification through the booking end and conflicts with APPROVED bookings and other active pending requests, excluding this request's own ID. A WAITLISTED request cannot be approved (REQUEST_WAITLISTED, 409); it moves up in order. REJECTED (reason required) may be applied to PENDING_APPROVAL or WAITLISTED requests; rejecting a pending request offers its time to the next waitlisted request. BOOKING_HOLD_CONFLICT (409) includes details.hold_until; BOOKING_CONFLICT (409) indicates an approved blocker. Nobody can decide a request that is for them or that they created (403 SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN). Urgent requests can be decided only by a Manager (403 URGENT_NEEDS_MANAGER).

patch.summary: Deactivate or reactivate an account (Manager only)
patch.description: Active Manager only. Send active (and optionally role, which must equal the current role). Roles are fixed when an account is created: Students, Admins and Managers are separate accounts, so any role change returns 409 ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED; to replace someone, add a new staff account and deactivate the old one. Takes effect on the user's next request; a deactivated user receives 401. Managers cannot change their own status (SELF_MODIFICATION_FORBIDDEN, 403), and at least one active Manager must remain (LAST_MANAGER, 409). Deactivating a student rejects their undecided (pending and waitlisted) requests with ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED and promotes the waitlist; approved bookings are kept. Every change writes a USER_UPDATED audit record with previous and new values.

get.description: No Authorization header (calendar apps cannot send one): the random token in the address is the only key. Returns the person's APPROVED bookings that end no earlier than 60 days ago, as text/calendar (RFC 5545). Each booking keeps UID <booking id>@smartlab and SEQUENCE grows with revision, so a rescheduled booking replaces its entry; cancelled bookings disappear. Read-only: nothing done in a calendar app changes a booking.

Website notifications are stored with the change they describe: booking approved or rejected (including automatic decisions and waitlist rejections), waitlisted request moved up, rescheduled by a Manager, cancelled by staff, booked for you by staff, induction reviewed, missed check-in, booking frozen or unfrozen; Managers also get urgent requests. Ordinary new requests are not notified to staff. Extra delivery channels (e.g. Outlook mail) are configured on the server with NOTIFICATION_CHANNELS.

Only the person the booking is for, on an APPROVED booking, from CHECK_IN_OPENS_MINUTES (default 15) before the start until CHECK_IN_CLOSES_MINUTES (default 30) after it (never after the end). Repeating returns the checked-in booking. Without a check-in the booking counts as missed (NO_SHOW) unless the resource was under maintenance or closed; at FREEZE_AFTER_NO_SHOWS (default 4) missed bookings the person's booking is frozen for FREEZE_DAYS (default 30) and their later bookings and requests are cancelled. post.summary: Ask to move your approved booking (change request)
post.description: 1.16.0. Only the person the booking is for, and only for a future APPROVED booking (409 REQUEST_NOT_CHANGEABLE otherwise; others receive 404 or 403). Creates a new request on the same resource with replaces_id set and the same purpose. It follows the normal request rules (booking window, opening hours, length, induction, freeze, weekly limit, where the old booking does not count). Free time: PENDING_APPROVAL with a review window; taken or held time: WAITLISTED. The old booking stays until the new request is approved (by an Admin, by the system when the review window ends, or after moving up the waitlist); then it is cancelled with reason_code REPLACED_BY_CHANGE and its time is offered to the waitlist. If the change is rejected, withdrawn or expires, the old booking stays. One open change per booking (409 CHANGE_ALREADY_REQUESTED with details.booking_id). The same time as now is 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Notifications CHANGE_REQUESTED, CHANGE_APPROVED, CHANGE_REJECTED. Optional Idempotency-Key header as for POST bookings/.

RequirementUpdate.description: 1.16.0: any of the texts and/or prerequisite_ids (replaces the list).

SiteContact.description: 1.16.0: the lab's contact details (one record). Empty strings until a Manager saves them; the website shows only filled-in fields.

SiteContactUpdate.description: Any of the fields; an empty string clears it. email must look like an address.

due_soon.description: Pending requests whose review window ends within due_soon_hours, soonest first (at most 10).

today.description: Approved bookings starting today (Sydney), at most 10.
